verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's own materials describe a built-in AI agent in ClickStack AI Notebooks that takes plain-language problem descriptions and queries logs, traces, and metrics for the user, which is in-product task delegation. That capability appears only on a waitlist/preview page and is scoped to observability. The MCP server and agent skills connect external assistants to ClickHouse, so they are not a built-in assistant and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: generally available in-product assistant, coverage beyond ClickStack observability (e.g., SQL/console tasks), in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: You can describe an issue in plain language, and the AI agent will query logs, traces, and metrics on your behalf — surfacing relevant data, charts, and summaries as a series of tiles.
